## 🔴 HIGH IMPACT

### GOOG / GOOGL — Alphabet Q3 2026 Earnings Miss | **BEARISH**
**Directional call: BEARISH** — AI capex spiral turning cash flow negative; street losing patience.

Alphabet reported Q3 2026 results after the close on October 28 and badly missed expectations. Revenue came in at **$127.6B**, below consensus, with net income falling despite the top-line being up ~25% YoY. The culprit: AI infrastructure capital expenditure, which the company had flagged at **$180B for full-year 2026**, is now running ahead of returns and pushed **free cash flow to negative $9.065B**. Shares tumbled **8–10%+ in premarket trading** Thursday. Bloomberg reported the headline as "Alphabet's AI Spending Outpaces Returns, Pressuring Revenue, Profit." Analyst commentary is split: some see AI investment as necessary; others warn the market is losing patience with indefinite cash burn timelines. Contagion from the GOOG miss is rippling into the entire semiconductor and AI infrastructure sector today.

### INTC — Intel Q3 2026 Earnings (Reporting Today) | **MIXED / WATCHING**
**Directional call: MIXED** — Make-or-break margin test; analyst targets cut ahead of report.

Intel is reporting Q3 2026 results today (October 29).
